ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity black surface exceeding 85% pixel coverage with high-intensity white punctate features scattered across the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mapping characterized by thousands of discrete, high-intensity white circular spots (2-10 pixels in diameter) against a contiguous low-intensity black background; no macro-scale white pigmentation patches are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations along the entire boundary; peak-to-valley pixel depth varies between 5 and 25 pixels, creating a saw-tooth profile.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge shows a strong concave curve approaching the median notch from the distal tips; leading edges exhibit a convex sweep towards the outer points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Pervasive spatial detection of high-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the entirety of both lobes, with higher density in the medial regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear trajectories; notably three parallel vertical rake marks on the mid-right lobe and several shorter diagonal scratches on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive trailing edge degradation and heavy surface scarring including both punctate rosette clusters and linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'stippled' appearance caused by the extreme density of white punctate marks against the uniform dark pigmentation of the fluke surface.
